title: EsriFootprint
description: Read-only inventory of an Esri estate (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, or FileGDB) produced by honua-esri-assess and consumed by the closed Honua migration product. Schema version esri-footprint/v0.1 (full SemVer in $id). v0.x is unstable — breaking changes are permitted within v0.x; v1.0 is the first stable promise.

schemaVersion.description: Major.minor of the contract carried in-band. Full SemVer (e.g. v0.1.0) lives in $id.

generatedAt.description: When the scanner finished producing this artifact (RFC3339 UTC).

inventory.description: Normalized records from the scanned source, discriminated by EsriItem.kind. Portal items, Server services, and FileGDB feature classes coexist in a single list.

diagnostics.description: Typed, prospect-safe diagnostics surfaced during scanning. Raw exceptions and stack traces are forbidden by project constraint and excluded from the schema.

RFC3339.description: RFC3339 UTC date-time string with an explicit Z suffix.

SemVer.description: Semantic version string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release/build metadata).

ToolProvenance.description: Scanner provenance. version is required so consumers can reason about which scanner produced the artifact.

name.description: Always honua-esri-assess at v0.1; other producers are not part of the contract.

Source.description: Identifies the scanned Esri source. Discriminated by kind. locator must be a prospect-safe identifier — never credentials, never raw on-prem paths; FileGDB paths are surfaced as a salted hash. locator format is constrained by kind via the allOf branches below.

locator.description: Prospect-safe identifier for the source. AGOL: host + organization id (e.g. honua.maps.arcgis.com/0123ABC). Server: base services URL with no query string, fragment, or userinfo. FileGDB: salted sha256 of the gdb path (sha256:<64 hex>).

capturedAt.description: When the scan against this source began.

SpatialReference.description: Spatial reference identification. Esri publishes wkid, latestWkid, or wkt inconsistently — at least one must be present. Closed object: producers must normalize to the documented keys before emitting.

Extent.description: Bounding box and spatial reference for an item or layer.

bbox.description: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in the crs coordinate system.

GeometryType.description: Esri geometry type tag. null is allowed for tables and non-spatial items.

FieldDescriptor.description: Minimal field metadata captured for FileGDB feature classes. Closed object: extras require a schema bump.

type.description: Esri field type tag (e.g. esriFieldTypeOID, esriFieldTypeString).

EsriTypeCountMap.description: Map of Esri item or service type labels to counts. Property names are constrained to display-label characters so URLs, query tokens, credential strings, and raw path fragments cannot be carried as map keys.

PortalFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == arcgis-online. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

orgUrl.description: ArcGIS Online organization base URL. Schema pattern rejects userinfo, query strings, and fragments so credentials and session tokens cannot ride along.

itemCounts.description: Map of Esri item type → count (e.g. "Feature Service": 12). Keys are constrained to prospect-safe type labels.

sharingSummary.description: Roll-up of sharing levels across portal items.

licensing.description: Read-only license entitlement observations from documented Portal Sharing endpoints.

ServerFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == arcgis-server. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

folders.description: Top-level service folder names. Empty array if all services live at the root.

serviceCounts.description: Map of Esri service type → count (e.g. "MapServer": 4). Keys are constrained to prospect-safe type labels.

licensing.description: Read-only license entitlement observations from documented ArcGIS Server REST/admin endpoints.

ExtensionEntitlement.description: One Esri extension or add-on observed during read-only entitlement enumeration.

code.description: Esri extension code as reported by the source, or the catalog-normalized equivalent.

UserTypeCount.description: Portal user-type entitlement count. Seat counts are omitted when the endpoint does not expose them for the scanner credential.

PortalPremiumContent.description: Portal premium content and add-on entitlement summary. Credit balances are intentionally reduced to a boolean.

PortalLicensing.description: Portal / ArcGIS Online licensing observations from read-only Sharing API endpoints.

ServiceExtensionRecord.description: SOEs and SOIs enabled on one ArcGIS Server service.

serviceUrl.description: Credentials-stripped service URL. Query strings, fragments, and userinfo are forbidden.

ServerLicensing.description: ArcGIS Server licensing observations from read-only REST/admin endpoints.

FileGdbFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == filegdb. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

pathHash.description: Salted sha256 of the FileGDB path. The raw path is never published.

version.description: FileGDB format version reported by the reader, when available.

EsriItem.description: Discriminated union of normalized inventory records. Variants are closed at v0.1: extras require a schema bump so the artifact cannot smuggle credentials or telemetry fields per item.

type.description: Esri portal item type (e.g. "Feature Service", "Web Map").

dependencies.description: Portal item ids this item references (e.g. webmap → services). Edges between layers/services are deferred to v0.2.

serviceUrl.description: Fully-qualified service URL with no query string, fragment, or userinfo. Credentials must never appear in this field.

serviceType.description: Esri service type (e.g. MapServer, FeatureServer, ImageServer).

folder.description: Folder name relative to the services root, or empty string if the service lives at the root.

Counts.description: Aggregate roll-up of the inventory. Top-level closed so adding a new aggregate is a deliberate schema bump.

items.description: Totals by EsriItem.kind: portal-item, server-service, filegdb-feature-class.

layers.description: Sum of layerCount across server-service items.

Diagnostic.description: Typed, prospect-safe diagnostic. code is drawn from a locked v0.1 enum; new codes require a v0.2 vocabulary expansion. Clarifying existing codes may land in a v0.1.x doc bump.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Must not contain raw stack traces, credentials, or full on-prem paths.

scope.description: Identifier of the affected area — usually source.kind, a folder, or an EsriItem identifier.

hint.description: Optional remediation hint surfaced to the prospect.
